description: Build an RFC-822 message and APPEND it to the Drafts folder. Does NOT send. Use for compose-and-review flows where the user wants to edit in their mail client before sending. To reply, pass reply_to_uid (+ reply_to_mailbox): recipient, Re: subject and threading headers are filled in from the original; explicit fields win.

account.description: Account ID (from list_accounts) to act on. Omit to use the default account.

include_signature.description: Append the account's signature (default true when one is set)

reply_to_uid.description: UID of the message being replied to

name: create_draft
